records.text: Owens said Thomas H. Patrick was escorted from his office in 2003 amid accusations that he orchestrated a political smear campaign against Eliot Spitzer.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Until 2003, he was unceremoniously escorted out of his office for a scandal in which he was accused of, of all things, orchestrating a political smear campaign against Elliot Spitzer, who he didn't like.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms an internal investigation into whether Patrick sought to fund media content disparaging Eliot Spitzer and that he abruptly left in 2003. It also reports Merrill concluded the matter was false. The specific claim that he was escorted from his office is not supported by the reviewed record.

sources.title: Plan to Discredit Spitzer Alleged
